verdict.rationale: Ledgy's own pages say share awards can be granted "one by one, or in bulk," with contracts created, signed and shared in a few clicks, and that granting workflows can be automated in bulk. Its cap-table page also says historical transaction data can be brought in with documents attached. All of this is marketing copy rather than detailed docs, and the historical-import claim never explicitly says bulk upload. missing for 10: documentation of the bulk upload mechanism (file format/template, validation, limits), explicit bulk import of historical transactions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
